headline: Sensex slips over 500 points and Nifty falls below 22,400 amid surging crude oil prices and FII outflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Surging crude oil prices pressured Indian equity markets
Continued foreign institutional investor (FII) outflows dragged key indices down
Declines in banking sector, including PSU banks, and hospital stocks weighed heavily
Weak global cues as US stocks fell ahead of major earnings and economic data
whatHappening: Sensex dropped over 500 points while Nifty 50 slid below the 22,400 level to close at 22,363
Nifty Smallcap 100 index outperformed the falling benchmark indices
NSE set a December 30 deadline for Polycab to exit F&O following recent insolvency developments
NCLAT placed an insolvency order against Polycab on hold
summary: Indian benchmark indices suffered sharp losses as Sensex fell 548 points and Nifty fell below 22,400. The market decline was primarily driven by rising crude oil prices, persistent FII selling, and weakness in banking stocks. In corporate news, Polycab faces an F&O exit deadline from NSE while NCLAT put its insolvency order on hold.
